text.tspan: EC2 storage: EBS vs instance store vs EFS
EBS: one instance at a time (except io1/io2 Multi-Attach) and locked to its AZ. Instance store: fastest, but data is lost on stop/terminate.
EFS: hundreds of instances in many AZs share one file system.
• provisioned size + IOPS, billed for it
• root volume deleted on terminate by
• physical disk on the host: best I/O
• grows automatically, pay per GB used
• access controlled by a security group
